channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies Plans Sale of Palm City Property
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies has announced it is planning to sell its Palm City property after consolidating tender-rigging operations at a Fort Lauderdale marina.

item.description: Fort Pierce city commissioners voted unanimously Monday night to reject a settlement offer in a lawsuit alleging years of waterfront mismanagement tied to historic restaurant Little Jim Bait & Tackle. item.title: 28-year-old man dies following weekend double shooting in Fort Pierce
item.description:
A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after he was shot multiple times in Fort Pierce over the weekend, according to police. The shooting happened early Sunday morning at about 3:43 a.m. in the 300 block of South 14th Street.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner faces $9,000 annual insurance bill, may be forced to sell home
item.description: Kelly Hagen says her homeowners insurance jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 a year, equating to $750 a month on top of her mortgage payment. Her insurance company requires impact windows, an expensive upgrade she has struggled to afford while working two jobs.

item.title: Martin County School District to cut staff, save nearly $4 million for upcoming school year
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $4 million from next year's budget. The plan includes eliminating 16 administrative and district-level positions and removing 42 unfilled instructional vacancies.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback victory over Egypt in World Cup
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and led Argentina to an improbable 3-2 victory over Egypt on Tuesday despite trailing by two with only 11 minutes of regulation time to play.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: The 44-year-old Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in round of 16
item.description: The United States lost 4-1 to Belgium on Monday night in Seattle, ending American hopes for a deep World Cup run at home.

item.description:

item.description: Ron DeSantis has likely wrapped his final regular bill-signing season, closing one of his last major opportunities to shape Florida law from the governor's desk. item.title: Publix recalls frozen organic blueberries in Florida, seven other states over E. coli contamination
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration has issued a recall for frozen Publix GreenWise Organic Blueberries due to possible E. coli contamination. The product was shipped to Publix stores throughout eight states including Florida.

item.title: Florida home buyers now need 17 months longer to save for down payment than a decade ago
item.description: A new study by Smart Asset found that it now takes the median-income household earner in Florida 17 months longer to save up for a down payment in 2026 than in 2016.

item.title: St. Lucie man with pancreatic cancer approved for experimental treatment
item.description: Russell Reed, a 64-year-old St. Lucie man battling pancreatic cancer, has been approved to receive daraxonrasib, an experimental drug his oncologist believes could help after traditional treatments were no longer effective.
